name: highlight_region
description: Colors residues in the 3D viewer, with no text. Use it when the user only wants color ("highlight", "color", "paint", "show in blue"). If the request includes any text for the residues (a label, note, name or annotation), call annotate_region instead and do not call this tool on those residues: annotate_region colors them too, and calling both lists the residues twice in the viewer. All residues listed in one call form ONE color highlight (one unlabelled entry in state.selections); returns its id. To color an entire chain, pass chains (e.g. ["B"]) instead of listing its residues. Highlights stack: the new one is drawn on top of every older entry, annotation notes included, where they overlap; those keep their residues and color, so deleting the new highlight shows them again.

chains.description: Whole chains the highlight covers, as author chain ids (auth_asym_id), e.g. ["B"]. Use this instead of listing residues when the user means an entire chain: the viewer fills in the chain's residues from the loaded structure (until then the entry's residues for that chain are empty) and lists it as "Chain B". May be combined with residues on other chains.

color.description: Highlight color name (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta) or #rgb / #rrggbb hex code.

end_auth_seq_id.description: Author residue number ending a single contiguous span (default: start_auth_seq_id).

residues.description: Residues the highlight covers, as ONE entry: author residue numbers (auth_seq_id; e.g. [6, 10] is residues 6 and 10, not 6 to 10) and/or {"auth_asym_id", "start_auth_seq_id", "end_auth_seq_id"} objects for spans or residues on other chains (e.g. [{"auth_asym_id": "A", "start_auth_seq_id": 57, "end_auth_seq_id": 60}, {"auth_asym_id": "B", "start_auth_seq_id": 102}]). Entries of activeSelection ({"startResidue", "endResidue"}) can be passed as they are; use this form to give residue names (auth_comp_id), which the other forms cannot carry. Numbers and objects may be mixed. "end_auth_seq_id" defaults to "start_auth_seq_id"; a missing auth_asym_id defaults to the auth_asym_id argument. All ids are author ids, never label_*.

anyOf.description: An author residue number on the default chain.

auth_asym_id.description: Author chain id (default: the auth_asym_id argument).

endResidue.description: Last residue, on the same chain (default: startResidue).

auth_asym_id.description: Author chain id (default: the chain of startResidue).

auth_comp_id.description: Residue name, e.g. "GLY" (_atom_site.auth_comp_id), when the user gives it or you read it from the structure file. Stored as given (not checked against the structure).

auth_asym_id.description: Author chain id (default: the auth_asym_id argument).

auth_comp_id.description: Residue name, e.g. "GLY" (_atom_site.auth_comp_id), when the user gives it or you read it from the structure file. Stored as given (not checked against the structure).

start_auth_seq_id.description: Author residue number starting a single contiguous span (alternative to residues).
